stable.releaseNotes: Refines full-backup retention: keep every validated full backup for 30 days, then retain one monthly recovery point for 12 months, always preserve the newest 3 validated full backups, and never prune a full backup unless a newer validated full backup exists. No workspace migration.

beta.releaseNotes: Next Beta baseline carrying forward Stable 0.10.14 monthly full-backup retention. No workspace migration.
